Marta (Support): Escalating to CS — Velora pilot is blocked during SSO provisioning. Ticket #19876 shows repeated 403s and quota_rejected after a bulk embed job. Trial ends in ~29 days, theyre mid-pilot and very close to demo readiness.
Evan (CS): Thanks Marta. Do we have tier / any committed spend?
Marta (Support): Pilot trial, no committed ARR. Error snippet: {"error":"quota_exceeded","code":403}. Logs attached in ticket.
Pri (SE): Seen this pattern: large batched embed + transient key rotation can break the provisioning webhook path. Quick mitigation: temporary quota bump (24-72h) and recommend client retry with smaller batches.
Evan (CS): Comms plan suggestion: 1) Immediate outreach acknowledging impact and steps taken, 2) Apply a 48h quota bump while we triage, 3) 30m troubleshooting call with SE + support, 4) Capture onboarding friction for docs. Owner: Dana to lead customer touch.
Dana (CS Manager): Ill own outreach. @Rae (AE) please add any commercial context and renewal sensitivity for the email. Ill draft a customer note and timeline.
Rae (AE): Please include a short reassuring line around prioritizing their pilot completion so we protect renewal motion. Tone: calm, proactive.
Marta (Support): Ticket update: "Escalated to CS. Applied +900 quota units for 48h. POC: Dana." Customer curl they used: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/provision -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"tenant":"velora"}'`
Pri (SE): Ill pull request traces and check key rotation windows. If callbacks delayed, that explains timeouts.
Olga (Docs): Ill draft a 2-line onboarding note about safe ingest batch sizes and SSO callback expectations by EOD tomorrow.
Evan (CS): Dana: please post your email draft here for quick review. After the call well log a 48h follow-up and set a renewal watch in CRM.
Dana (CS Manager): Scheduled troubleshooting call: 2024-06-12 14:00 PST (30m). Action items: (A) Dana: send customer email + own outreach, (B) Pri: confirm quota bump and provide traces, (C) Docs: add runbook note, (D) CS: set renewal watch flag in CRM and schedule 7d check-in.
Marta (Support): Adding final ticket note: "Customer tentatively unblocked after quota bump; awaiting scheduled call. If still blocked escalate to eng oncall."
Dana (CS Manager): Thanks team — will paste the customer-facing message here in 15m. Well follow with a short postmortem if root cause is platform-side. :thumbsup:
-- end thread --
